title: Late Autumn Sketches
summary: An entry centered on seasonal color, study pieces, and the unfinished quality of autumn work.
main_text:
The sketches in this room carried the atmosphere of late autumn without relying on obvious symbols. Browns leaned toward gray, reds felt tired rather than celebratory, and empty space did as much work as the marks themselves. Nothing was overstated. That restraint made the season feel truthful.

Study pieces can be more revealing than finished paintings because they show what the artist chose to keep provisional. Here the unfinished edges mattered. They suggested weather, fading light, and the sense that everything seen outdoors was already on its way to changing again.

I found the room unexpectedly calming. Autumn is often described through drama, but these works understood another register: the slow administrative work of endings. They made transition look ordinary, and because of that, moving.
